[Shot 1] In a low-angle medium shot, <Subject 2> is captured descending a staircase within <Subject 4>. She grips the black metal handrail with her right hand, her <Subject 1> face visible from a three-quarter profile. Her long black leather loafers strike the concrete steps with a rhythmic precision. Her blonde, wavy hair flows gently with the downward motion. The camera tracks her descent with a smooth pan at a moderate speed, maintaining her centered composition as she moves from the top landing toward the camera.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the shot continues as she reaches the end of the second flight. Her pace slows, and she pivots gracefully onto the tiled landing. The camera continues its smooth pan, following her movement toward the background. The large window with its distinctive wired-glass pattern becomes the focal point. <Subject 1> (S1) turns her chin upward and toward the window, her gaze now directed at her own reflection. A subtle, contemplative micro-expression is visible on her red lips. The movement of her beige tote bag against her grey trousers provides a soft visual anchor as she holds her pose. The shot concludes with her stillness against the backdrop of the urban sky visible through the glass.
